verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS and self-hostable feature-flag platform, but no item in the pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking setting or opt-out mechanism. Self-hosting is described as giving 'full control over your data', but that statement says nothing about whether the product sends telemetry or can be told not to, so it is not credited as evidence for this story.
